notes_for_editor: The 1958 NGS description gives 93 ft high; not stored as height_m because the datasheet does not say height to the cab floor. The 2012 recovery note is the only record after 1958 and says the lookout tower is removed. NGS landmarks named in the description (Collierville, Fisherville) were not checked against the Fayette County attribution. Record county, elevation (126.5 m) and removed status agree with Landforms. No photos.
